properties.name: jwt.secret.base64
properties.description: Base64 encoded HS512 signing key for access and refresh tokens (at least 64 bytes). Override with JWT_SECRET_BASE64.

properties.name: jwt.refresh-token-validity-in-seconds
properties.description: Refresh token lifetime in seconds; also the max age of the refreshToken cookie.

properties.name: app.cors.allowed-origins
properties.description: Comma separated list of origins allowed by CORS.

properties.name: app.seed.admin-email
properties.description: Email of the default admin account created on first start when no account exists.

properties.name: app.seed.admin-password
properties.description: Password of the default admin account created on first start.

properties.name: app.attendance.pull.enabled
properties.description: Run the nightly pull of punches from the attendance devices. Off by default so a developer machine never contacts a real device.

properties.name: app.attendance.pull.cron
properties.description: Cron expression (Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh time) of the nightly pull. Default 01:00.

properties.name: app.attendance.pull.python
properties.description: Command that starts Python, used to run the pull script.

properties.name: app.attendance.pull.script-dir
properties.description: Folder that holds the pull scripts. Each device names its script (default zk_pull_punches.py).

properties.name: app.attendance.pull.output-dir
properties.description: Folder for the temporary CSV and log of each pull.

properties.name: app.attendance.pull.timeout-minutes
properties.description: A pull that takes longer than this many minutes is stopped.

properties.name: app.attendance.pull.overlap-hours
properties.description: Each pull re-reads this many hours before the newest stored punch; duplicates are dropped by the importer.

properties.name: app.attendance.pull.devices
properties.description: Devices to pull, each with branch-code, ip, port (default 4370), password (default 0) and script (default zk_pull_punches.py).
